dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of valid run records indexed by dimensions m and n. Its constructor D014 packages matrices A, Q, and R, dimension and rank assumptions, a real error parameter, exact leading-block inverses, smallness assumptions, and step and prefix certificates.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target is universal only over data packaged as such a valid run, so all restrictions stored in this record are implicit hypotheses of the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fifth field of a run, namely its real m by n matrix Q.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its first k+1 columns form the matrix whose orthogonality defect is bounded.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The sixth field of a run, namely its real n by n matrix R.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its leading (k+1) by (k+1) block occurs in the condition-number factor and in the second-order coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ninth field of a run, a real number epsilonM satisfying 0 < epsilonM < 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first- and second-order perturbation parameter on the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each k in Fin n, the twelfth field of a run supplies a real (k+1) by (k+1) matrix that is both a left and right inverse of the leading block of R.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The norm of this exact inverse enters both the squared condition-number factor and the second-order coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real constant c(m,r) = alpha(m,r) + 2 beta(m,r), where alpha is D024 and beta is D022.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For r=k+1, this is the main dimension-dependent constant multiplying the squared condition number and epsilonM, and it also appears inside the second-order coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m by n matrix and k in Fin n, it restricts the matrix to its first k+1 columns, producing an m by (k+1) matrix; index casts preserve the underlying column numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the prefixes A_s and Q_s used in the certificates and the conclusion, with s=k+1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For two square matrices of the same size, it is the product of their induced Euclidean operator norms.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to R_s and its supplied inverse S_s, it gives kappa_s = ||R_s||_2 ||S_s||_2, which is squared in the first-order term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an n by n matrix R and k in Fin n, it selects the leading principal (k+1) by (k+1) block by preserving both row and column indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines R_s in the condition number, inverse assumptions, certificates, and second-order coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The induced Euclidean, or spectral operator, norm of a real square matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures the orthogonality defect, R_s, its inverse, and square residuals appearing in certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m by r matrix Q, it is the r by r matrix I_r - Q^T Q.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The left-hand side is exactly ||I_s - Q_s^T Q_s||_2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: For s=k+1, let a=||A_s||_2, rho=||R_s||_2, sigma=||S_s||_2, and let f_s, g_s, h_s be the factorization, normal-equation, and reverse-norm second-order coefficients stored in the prefix certificate. With beta=beta(m,s), alpha=alpha(m,s), and c=c(m,s), define t=(alpha/2)rho+h_s, u=2rho t+t^2, v=g_s+2a f_s+(beta a+f_s)^2. This definition returns E_s=sigma^2(cu+v).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: E_s is the coefficient multiplying epsilonM squared in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fourth field of a run, namely its real m by n matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A does not occur visibly on the left-hand side, but its prefix norm and its certificate data determine E_s and the admissibility of the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run constructor requires 0<m, 0<n, n<=m; real matrices A,Q of size m by n and R of size n by n; injectivity of x maps to Ax; upper triangularity R_ij=0 when j<i; epsilonM with 0<epsilonM<1; exact two-sided inverses for every leading block of R; c(m,k+1) epsilonM kappa_k^2<1 for every k; one step certificate for every column; and one prefix certificate for every prefix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines all packaged hypotheses under which the displayed inequality is asserted.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The seventeenth field of a run, assigning to each k a prefix certificate for A_s, Q_s, R_s, and epsilonM, where s=k+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its three stored second-order coefficients are used to compute E_s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef016(r) is the type of real r by r matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the dimensions of R, its leading blocks and inverses, and all square residual and defect matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef017(m,n) is the type of real m by n matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the dimensions of A, Q, and their prefixes.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certificate type for an m by r factorization triple A,Q,R at error parameter epsilonM. Constructor D032 supplies its exact witnesses, equations, nonnegativity conditions, and norm bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run contains one such certificate for each prefix, and its coefficients determine the second-order term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The third field of a prefix certificate, its nonnegative factorization second-order coefficient f.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes 2||A_s||_2 f and (beta||A_s||_2+f)^2 to E_s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fourth field of a prefix certificate, its nonnegative normal-equation second-order coefficient g.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is added directly to the core remainder in E_s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fifth field of a prefix certificate, its nonnegative reverse-norm second-order coefficient h.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in t=(alpha/2)||R_s||_2+h when E_s is computed.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real constant beta(m,r), equal to 1 when r=1 and otherwise equal to 2r sqrt(2m)+2 sqrt(r), with natural numbers cast to reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes to c=alpha+2beta and to the factorization part (beta||A_s||_2+f_s)^2 of E_s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural numeral 1+1=2 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It only enables interpretation of the numeral 2 in types requiring a real natural-number cast; it adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real constant alpha(m,r), equal to m+2 when r=1 and otherwise equal to (7/2)m r^2-(3/2)m r+16r.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes to c, to the normal-equation certificate bound, and through alpha/2 to E_s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real constant alpha(m,r)/2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the slope term (alpha/2)||R_s||_2 in E_s and appears in the reverse-norm certificate bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: The identity matrix I_r of the requested square dimension r.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in I_s-Q_s^TQ_s and in the exact inverse equations for R_s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: For k in Fin n, a proof that k.val+1<=n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It justifies embedding indices of each prefix into the full matrix dimensions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary finite-dimensional real matrix multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Q_sR_s, Q_s^TQ_s, A_s^TA_s, and related certificate products.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: The induced Euclidean operator norm of a real rectangular matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives ||A_s||_2 and the factorization-error norm in prefix certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix transpose.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Q_s^TQ_s and A_s^TA_s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: A per-column computation certificate indexed by A,Q,R,epsilonM and a column k. Constructor D037 gives its exact intermediate quantities, equations, positivity conditions, and componentwise error bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: One such certificate for every column is required for a run, but its fields do not occur directly in the displayed bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: A prefix certificate consists of matrices DeltaA and N and nonnegative reals f,g,h satisfying Q R=A+DeltaA, N=R^T R-A^T A, ||DeltaA||_2<=beta(m,r)||A||_2 epsilonM+f epsilonM^2, ||N||_2<=alpha(m,r)||A||_2^2 epsilonM+g epsilonM^2, and ||A||_2<=(1+(alpha(m,r)/2)epsilonM)||R||_2+h epsilonM^2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For each run prefix, these conditions provide the coefficients f,g,h from which E_s is computed.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the numeral 6+1=7 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It only supports the real numeral 7 in alpha and adds no mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the numeral 2+1=3 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It only supports the real numeral 3 in alpha and adds no mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the numeral 15+1=16 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It only supports the real numeral 16 in alpha and adds no mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of two real square matrices of a specified dimension.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states the two-sided inverse equations and forms R^TR in normal-equation residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: A step certificate at column t stores s_j, v_i, psi, phi, projection and residual errors, scalar errors, normalization errors, and lambda>=0. It requires s_j=0 for j>=t. If t=0, R_00=||A_:0||_2+diagonalError and Q_i0=A_i0/R_00+normalizationError_i. If t>0, then for j<t, s_j=<Q_:j,A_:t>+projectionError_j and R_jt=s_j; v_i=A_it-sum_{j<t}Q_ij s_j+residualError_i; psi=||A_:t||_2+psiError; phi=||s||_2+phiError; psi>=0, phi>=0, psi-phi>=0; R_tt=sqrt(psi-phi)sqrt(psi+phi)+diagonalError; and Q_it=v_i/R_tt+normalizationError_i. It also requires R_tt>0 and bounds every listed error in absolute value by lambda epsilonM.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These certificates restrict admissible runs and encode the columnwise computation model, though the displayed inequality uses only the separately stored prefix certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m by r matrix A and r by r matrix R, it is R^T R-A^T A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact normal-equation residual N required by each prefix certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean norm of a selected column of a real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the base-column and positive-column equations of each step certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean inner product sum_i Q_ij A_ik between column j of Q and column k of A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact projection quantity perturbed by projectionError in a positive-index step certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: The component A_ik-sum_{j<k}Q_ij s_j of the residual vector before residualError is added.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the computed residual-vector equation in each positive-index step certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: Transpose of a square matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms R^T in the normal-equation residual.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a finite real vector x, its Euclidean norm sqrt(sum_i x_i^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines column norms and the norm of the coefficient vector s in step certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type consisting of natural numbers strictly below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes rows, columns, and the chosen prefix endpoint k.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: The underlying natural-number value of a finite index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies s=k.val+1 and expresses index-order conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At the instantiated types it denotes real scalar multiplication or matrix multiplication as determined by the supplied instance.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched exponentiation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here it supplies ordinary natural powers of reals, specifically squares.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched non-strict order.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-number power operation induced by a monoid.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of a natural-number literal in a type with an OfNat instance.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real-number type.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the addition in the right-hand side and scalar formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual non-strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the target an ordinary real inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides ordinary real natural powers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all scalar products in the bound and definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms k.val+1 and numeral sums used in dimensions.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-addition instance derived from an ordinary Add instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes homogeneous additions to the standard natural, real, or matrix addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-multiplication instance derived from an ordinary Mul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it routes all homogeneous products to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-power instance derived from a power operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes real powers with natural exponents to ordinary real exponentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The instance interpreting a natural literal n as the natural number n itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural literals used for prefix increments and exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given r<=n, it embeds Fin r into Fin n while preserving the underlying value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It realizes prefix extraction without changing row or column numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration of all elements of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes all matrix products, inner products, and norms finite sums.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes ordinary real or entrywise matrix subtraction in defect and residual formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type I, column type J, and entries in a type alpha is a function I -> J -> alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the concrete finite real arrays represented by LocalDef016 and LocalDef017.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instL2OpNormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normed additive-group structure on finite real matrices whose norm is the induced l2 operator norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes every matrix norm in the proposition as an operator 2-norm rather than a Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.sub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Entrywise subtraction of matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms I-Q^TQ and R^TR-A^TA entrywise.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.succ
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number successor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses k.val+1 and the proof that each prefix size is at most n.

dependency_coverage.name: Norm.norm
dependency_coverage.meaning: The norm operation supplied by a Norm instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the matrix l2-operator-norm instance it evaluates all displayed matrix norms.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup.toNorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: The norm structure underlying a normed additive commutative group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It exposes the matrix operator norm used by LocalDef010 and LocalDef029.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard embedding of natural numbers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets m, r, and numerical constants in alpha and beta as real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instRCLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: The RCLike structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the analytic scalar structure needed to define the l2 operator norm; it adds no extra proposition-level hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary subtraction on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies scalar differences such as psi-phi and the subtraction in alpha.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Decidable equality on finite indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports identity matrices, finite sets, and matrix norm infrastructure without adding a mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-subtraction instance derived from an ordinary Sub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes real and matrix subtraction to their standard operations.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a type with natural casts, it interprets any numeral proved to be at least two by its natural-number cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real numerals such as 2, 3, 7, and 16 in the constant formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation supplied by a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it supplies the divisions in 1/2, 3/2, 7/2, and vector normalization.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states exact matrix inverse, triangularity, factorization, residual, and step-certificate equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Function.Injective
dependency_coverage.meaning: A function f is injective when f(a1)=f(a2) implies a1=a2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to x maps to Ax, it requires A to have a trivial kernel, equivalently full column rank over the reals.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At real arguments it denotes ordinary real division in normalization equations and constants.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses positive dimensions, 0<epsilonM<1, positive diagonal entries, index order, and the smallness condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Standard finite matrix multiplication, with each output entry given by the dot product over the shared index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact meaning of all matrix products in defects, inverse equations, and certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.mulVec
dependency_coverage.meaning: Standard matrix-vector multiplication by finite row-wise dot products.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its injectivity for A is a packaged run hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.one
dependency_coverage.meaning: The square identity matrix with ones on the diagonal and zeros elsewhere.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies I_s in the orthogonality defect and inverse equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.transpose
dependency_coverage.meaning: The matrix transpose, interchanging row and column indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Q_s^T, A_s^T, and R_s^T.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.AtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proposition certifying that a natural number is at least two.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-number casting function into a type with a NatCast instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It embeds dimensions and natural constants into the reals in alpha and beta.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: The semiring-like structure underlying a nonunital nonassociative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the algebra required by matrix-vector multiplication without changing the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonunital commutative-ring structure underlying a nonunital normed commutative ring.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The instance interpreting the numeral 1 as the multiplicative identity.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real multiplicative identity 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies scalar one in epsilonM<1, constants, and matrix identities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard normed commutative-ring structure of the real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqNat

dependency_coverage.name: instLENat

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive group structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports real negation and absolute value in error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The lattice-order structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the standard real absolute-value operation.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: Absolute value, defined as max(a,-a) in the ordered additive group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures every componentwise error in a step certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.filter
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite subset of elements satisfying a decidable predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the residual sum to previous columns j<t.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines Euclidean norms, inner products, matrix products, and residual vectors.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the complete finite row or column index sets in sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.decLt
dependency_coverage.meaning: A decision procedure for strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the filter j<t and other index-order branches computationally decidable, without adding a hypothesis.

binders: m and n are arbitrary natural numbers, implicit in the theorem.
run is an arbitrary valid run record of dimensions m and n.
k is an arbitrary element of Fin n, so 0<=k.val<n; write s=k.val+1, hence 1<=s<=n.
hypotheses: It packages real matrices A,Q in R^(m by n) and R in R^(n by n), with the map x maps to Ax injective and with R upper triangular: R_ij=0 whenever j<i.
For every t in Fin n, with r=t.val+1, it packages a matrix S_r in R^(r by r) satisfying S_r R_r=I_r and R_r S_r=I_r, where R_r is the leading principal block of R.
For every t in Fin n it assumes c(m,r) epsilon (||R_r||_2 ||S_r||_2)^2<1.
For every column t it packages a step certificate with all equations, positivity conditions, and componentwise error bounds stated in the mathematical definitions.

For every prefix r=t.val+1 it packages a prefix certificate with witnesses DeltaA_r,N_r and nonnegative coefficients f_r,g_r,h_r satisfying the exact equations and norm bounds stated in the mathematical definitions.
conclusions: For s=k.val+1, ||I_s-Q_s^T Q_s||_2 <= c(m,s) (||R_s||_2 ||S_s||_2)^2 epsilon + E_s epsilon^2.
mathematical_definitions: Fin r indexes 0,...,r-1. A_r and Q_r are the first r columns of A and Q, R_r is the leading principal r by r block of R, and S_r is the supplied exact two-sided inverse of R_r. All matrix norms ||.||_2 are induced Euclidean operator norms.

Define beta(m,r)=1 if r=1, and beta(m,r)=2r sqrt(2m)+2 sqrt(r) otherwise. Define alpha(m,r)=m+2 if r=1, and alpha(m,r)=(7/2)m r^2-(3/2)m r+16r otherwise. Define c(m,r)=alpha(m,r)+2 beta(m,r). Natural dimensions in these expressions are cast to reals.

A prefix certificate for A_r,Q_r,R_r consists of DeltaA_r, N_r, and f_r,g_r,h_r>=0 such that Q_r R_r=A_r+DeltaA_r, N_r=R_r^T R_r-A_r^T A_r, ||DeltaA_r||_2<=beta(m,r)||A_r||_2 epsilon+f_r epsilon^2, ||N_r||_2<=alpha(m,r)||A_r||_2^2 epsilon+g_r epsilon^2, and ||A_r||_2<=(1+(alpha(m,r)/2)epsilon)||R_r||_2+h_r epsilon^2.

For the selected prefix s, set a_s=||A_s||_2, rho_s=||R_s||_2, sigma_s=||S_s||_2, t_s=(alpha(m,s)/2)rho_s+h_s, u_s=2rho_s t_s+t_s^2, and v_s=g_s+2a_s f_s+(beta(m,s)a_s+f_s)^2. Then E_s=sigma_s^2(c(m,s)u_s+v_s).

A step certificate at column t stores a vector z indexed by Fin n, a vector v indexed by Fin m, scalars psi and phi, error vectors projectionError, residualError, and normalizationError, scalar errors psiError, phiError, and diagonalError, and a scale lambda>=0. It requires z_j=0 for every j>=t.
For t=0, the step certificate requires R_00=||A_:0||_2+diagonalError and Q_i0=A_i0/R_00+normalizationError_i for every i.

For t>0, it requires z_j=sum_i Q_ij A_it+projectionError_j and R_jt=z_j for j<t; v_i=A_it-sum_{j<t}Q_ij z_j+residualError_i; psi=||A_:t||_2+psiError; phi=sqrt(sum_j z_j^2)+phiError; psi>=0, phi>=0, and psi-phi>=0; R_tt=sqrt(psi-phi)sqrt(psi+phi)+diagonalError; and Q_it=v_i/R_tt+normalizationError_i.

Every step certificate also requires R_tt>0 and the bounds |projectionError_j|<=lambda epsilon, |residualError_i|<=lambda epsilon, |psiError|<=lambda epsilon, |phiError|<=lambda epsilon, |diagonalError|<=lambda epsilon, and |normalizationError_i|<=lambda epsilon for all applicable indices.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every valid packaged run and every nonempty leading prefix ending at column k, the operator-norm defect from orthonormality of the computed prefix Q_s is at most a first-order term c(m,s) times the square of the operator-norm condition factor of the corresponding leading block R_s, times epsilon, plus the explicitly computed certificate-dependent coefficient E_s times epsilon squared.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem quantifies over run records rather than arbitrary matrices. For dimensions or matrix data admitting no such run, the universal statement has no instance to which it applies.
Because a run requires 0<m, 0<n, and n<=m, no conclusion is provided for zero dimensions or for n>m.
Only prefixes of sizes s=k+1 with 1<=s<=n are covered; there is no size-zero prefix case.
The smallness condition c(m,s) epsilon (||R_s||_2||S_s||_2)^2<1 is an assumption for every prefix, not a conclusion.
The norm is the induced Euclidean operator norm, not the Frobenius norm or an entrywise norm.

The second-order coefficient E_s depends on the particular stored prefix-certificate coefficients f_s,g_s,h_s. These coefficients need not be minimal or unique and may be enlarged while preserving their certificate inequalities, weakening the resulting bound.
The local step-error scale lambda is required only to be nonnegative and has no encoded upper bound, so the componentwise step-error assumptions alone do not impose a fixed universal error constant.
The proposition does not itself construct Q, R, their inverses, or the certificates; all are supplied as data in the run.
No concrete floating-point format, rounding mode, underflow or overflow behavior, or executable algorithm is encoded beyond the abstract step equations and error bounds.
Although real division is total in Lean, every normalization denominator R_tt is separately required to be strictly positive.
The conclusion bounds only the orthogonality defect I_s-Q_s^TQ_s; it does not directly conclude a forward error, backward error, factorization residual, or uniqueness statement.
